title: Volcano Engine Officially Launches Doubao Search Open Service to Empower Intelligent Agent Long-Term Tasks

content_html:
As AI Agents gradually shift from simple Q&A interactions to complex long-term task execution, traditional single-retrieval models have become insufficient to meet their demand for deep information. To address this, Volc Engine has officially launched the Douba Search service, aiming to provide enterprises and developers with comprehensive online information support across languages, modalities, and vertical categories to build intelligent agents.

In terms of information acquisition and credibility governance, Douba Search has undergone a comprehensive upgrade. The service can directly output structured data and Markdown source text, supporting precise targeted queries, wide-scope semantic rewriting, and multi-round retrieval enhancement, and can automatically adjust retrieval strategies as tasks progress. Meanwhile, to address issues such as low-quality internet content and SEO spam, the platform has established an authority grading system and vertical governance mechanism from the perspectives of website sites and creators. It integrates full-range internet information, industry-specific knowledge, and ByteDance's exclusive content resources, filtering out invalid information at the source to ensure the authenticity and reliability of results.

The service is currently widely applied in diverse scenarios such as knowledge Q&A, office collaboration, financial research, business analysis, and content production, meeting the core needs of domestic mainstream mobile phone smart assistants and various productivity agents. In terms of access methods, enterprises and developers can either independently integrate through API, Skill, or MCP formats, or configure it with one click within the Volc Engine Agent Plan. Additionally, the platform provides 500 free searches per month, with optional pay-as-you-go or discounted monthly package plans for usage beyond that, helping developers efficiently build high-quality AI applications.

content_html_zh:
随着AI Agent逐渐从简单的问答交互转向复杂的长期任务执行，传统的单一检索模型已经不足以满足其对深度信息的需求。 针对这一问题，Volc Engine正式推出豆霸搜索服务，旨在为企业和开发者提供跨语言、跨模式、跨垂直品类的全面在线信息支持，打造智能代理。

在信息获取和信用治理方面，豆巴搜索进行了全面升级。 该服务可以直接输出结构化数据和Markdown源文本，支持精准定向查询、大范围语义重写和多轮检索增强，并可以随着任务进展自动调整检索策略。 同时，针对网络内容质量低劣、SEO垃圾等问题，平台从网站和创作者的角度建立了权威分级体系和垂直治理机制。 它整合了全方位的互联网信息、行业知识以及字节跳动的独家内容资源，从源头过滤掉无效信息，确保结果的真实性和可靠性。

该服务目前广泛应用于知识问答、办公协作、金融研究、商业分析、内容制作等多种场景，满足国内主流手机智能助手和各类生产力代理人的核心需求。 在接入方式上，企业和开发者既可以通过API、Skill、MCP格式独立集成，也可以在Volc Engine Agent Plan中一键配置。 此外，该平台每月提供 500 次免费搜索，除此之外还可选按量付费或包月折扣套餐计划，帮助开发者高效构建高质量的 AI 应用。
